bybit.caveats:
1) Scope: I fetched all 23 symbols x 4 bars = 92 rows. Every requested candle exists. None is -1.
2) Timestamps: Bybit v5 kline startTime (list[0]) is in milliseconds. interval=60 means a 1-hour bar. For each row the script kept only the candle whose startTime is exactly the requested instant in ms, and it records that value in the note (for example 1788116400000 = 2026-08-30T19:00:00Z).
3) Volume field: quote_volume_usd is Bybit's own 'turnover' field (list[6]). That is the notional traded in USDT, summed from the fills. No conversion with close or a multiplier was applied. Linear contracts have a multiplier of 1 base unit. 'volume' (list[5]) is in base units (shares) and appears in the note as base_vol. As a check, base_vol x close is close to turnover. The rows treat USDT as equal to USD without adjusting for the USDT/USD rate.
4) Eight bars have a real candle with 0 volume and 0 turnover: LLY 08-30 and 09-20, JPM 09-13, EWJ 08-30 and 09-07, NOK(NOKIAUSDT) 09-13. These are hours with no trades, so the rows report 0, not -1.
5) NOK maps to Bybit symbol NOKIAUSDT, as given in venue_symbols.json.
6) Fetched 2026-09-23 around 08:20 UTC. Raw results: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-stas-workspace-other-prop-strategy/8264e0b6-3c34-4ace-8fc7-ffdb42610a75/scratchpad/bybit_bars.json. Script: .../scratchpad/bybit_k.py. No repo changes.

Every candle had confirm=1 (closed). quote_volume_usd is OKX's native volCcyQuote field (candle index 7), which is quote-currency volume in USDT; USDT is counted 1:1 as USD, with no conversion applied. I did not convert from contracts. As a cross-check I computed contracts x ctVal (ctVal=1 share for all 22 SWAPs, from /api/v5/public/instruments?instType=SWAP) x bar close. That product is within about 0.5% of volCcyQuote on every row; the gap is expected, since volCcyQuote is summed per trade while the check uses one close price. OKX volume counts one side only, not buys plus sells added together. Raw responses are saved in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-stas-workspace-other-prop-strategy/8264e0b6-3c34-4ace-8fc7-ffdb42610a75/scratchpad/okx_bars.json and the script is okx_bars.py in the same folder. hyperliquid.kline_endpoint: POST https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info {"type":"candleSnapshot","req":{"coin":"xyz:<TICKER>","interval":"1h","startTime":<ms>,"endTime":<ms>}}; I asked for the window [target-1h, target+2h] and kept only the candle with t == target ms
hyperliquid.caveats:
The USD values are computed, not reported by the venue. Hyperliquid candleSnapshot returns only base-asset volume "v", in units of the underlying, with no quote-volume field. quote_volume_usd = v × that bar's close. The contract multiplier is 1: an HL perp is sized in units of the asset, and xyz perps settle in USDC, which I treat as USD. Because the conversion uses the close, not a VWAP, each value is off by roughly the hour's intrabar price range, well under 1% for these bars.

I checked the timestamps against the exact requested instants. "t" is the open time in milliseconds, and each kept candle has t equal to the requested instant in ms. Each also has i == "1h" and T − t == 3599999 ms. The four opens are 1788116400000, 1788807600000, 1789326000000 and 1789930800000. All 76 rows (19 symbols × 4 bars) exist. None is -1.

Two bars have zero volume: xyz:NOK on 2026-08-30 and xyz:EWJ on 2026-09-20. In both the candle exists with n=0 trades and v=0.0, so 0 is the true volume, not a missing bar.

Every symbol is on the HIP-3 builder dex "xyz", so these volumes cover that dex only.

I made no repo changes. The raw output and the script are in the scratchpad: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-stas-workspace-other-prop-strategy/8264e0b6-3c34-4ace-8fc7-ffdb42610a75/scratchpad/hl_bars.json, hl_rows.json and hl_bars.py. I fetched the data on 2026-09-23.

gate.caveats:
All 92 rows are here: 23 symbols times 4 bars. 81 bars exist and 11 do not. The 11 missing ones are all the 2026-08-30T19:00:00Z bar. For 10 of those symbols (CRCL, MSTR, QQQ, AAPL, META, HOOD, COIN, TSLA, SPY, PLTR), Gate's launch_time for the contract is 2026-09-03T06:00:00Z. For AMZN it is 2026-08-31T10:00:00Z. Both are after the requested bar, so Gate returned an empty array and those rows are set to -1.

Timestamps: Gate's candle field t is in unix SECONDS, and the interval is named "1h". I set from and to to the same instant: 1788116400 (2026-08-30 19:00Z), 1788807600 (09-07), 1789326000 (09-13) and 1789930800 (09-20). The script kept a candle only when int(t) exactly equalled the requested instant. Every returned candle matched.

Volume units: quote_volume_usd is Gate's own "sum" field, which is the traded amount in USDT for that bar. It is USDT, treated as USD, with no peg adjustment. The "v" field is a count of contracts. As a cross-check I computed v x quanto_multiplier x close. The multiplier is 0.01 for most symbols, 0.1 for CRCL, INTC and NOK, and 0.001 for LLY. The check agrees with sum within about 0.3% on every bar. The small gap is expected because sum uses the actual fill prices, not the bar close. Each note records the v, multiplier and cross-check value.

Fetched on 2026-09-23 from the public endpoint with no keys. No repo changes were made. Scratch files are gate_bars.py, gate_bars.json and gate_rows.json in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-stas-workspace-other-prop-strategy/8264e0b6-3c34-4ace-8fc7-ffdb42610a75/scratchpad/.

kraken.kline_endpoint: GET https://futures.kraken.com/api/charts/v1/trade/{symbol}/1h?from={unix_s}&to={unix_s} (public, no keys; tick type 'trade' = traded-price candles; response 'time' is open time in MILLISECONDS)
kraken.caveats: Kraken Futures candles report volume in base units (contracts). All 11 instruments have contractSize 1 (from /derivatives/api/v3/instruments), so quote_volume_usd = volume x 1 x that bar's close. This is an approximation: it prices the whole hour at the closing price, not a true VWAP notional. Candle 'time' is in milliseconds. Every returned row was matched exactly on time == requested epoch_s*1000 (for example 2026-08-30T19:00Z = 1788116400000). The interval is named '1h'. The 'trade' tick type was used; the 'spot' and 'mark' series report volume 0. The value 0 means Kraken returned a candle for that hour with zero traded volume and a carried-over close. That is different from -1, which means no candle exists. The only -1 is SNDK on 2026-08-30: PF_SNDKUSD openingDate is 2026-09-03T11:58:28Z and the API returned an empty candle list. The script and raw rows are in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-stas-workspace-other-prop-strategy/8264e0b6-3c34-4ace-8fc7-ffdb42610a75/scratchpad/kraken_bars.py and kraken_rows.json.
